title: Introducing the Skin Knowledge Portal!
summary: Are you a researcher interested in advancing your understanding of skin disease through large-scale genomic data?
bodyHtml:
Check out The Skin Knowledge Portal (skin.hugeamp.org), which enables browsing, searching, and analysis of human genetic information linked to skin diseases and related traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

The Skin Knowledge Portal is being developed by the Skin Genetics Consortium (SGC), an international network of scientists and clinicians collaborating to advance our understanding of the genetic underpinnings of skin diseases by leveraging large-scale genomic data, with a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard.

We invite you to contribute datasets to support collaborative discovery.

If you are interested in connecting and contributing, or have any questions, please contact us at help@kp4cd.org.
